SMTO-UI-0053 — Indexing progress is unavailable

GUID: 7a0d448f-cb59-52f8-bc7c-64131345f35d
Slug: ui-status-incompatible
Domain: UI · Subsystem: browser

What happened

  • SMTO couldn't show memory indexing progress because the server didn't send it in a form this page understands. This usually means the server is older than this page. Memory and search may still be working.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Select Open System Health in this message and look at the Knowledge and Memory card. That card checks memory and search directly, so you can see whether they actually work.
  2. Ask your administrator to check for an SMTO server update in Settings › Setup › Server updates. This page expects a newer server that reports indexing progress.
  3. After the update finishes, reload this page. The reloaded page reads progress from the updated server.

What success looks like

  • Memory indexing progress appears without this message.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't copy an older or different SMTO installation over this one to fix it; use the normal server update.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Indexing progress is unavailable.

What this means

  • The server response lacks supported progress information. Search availability must be checked separately. The original operation and completed work retain their own recorded outcomes; this diagnostic does not replay them.

Why this can happen

  • The component reported ui_status_incompatible. This does not establish the outcome of unrelated operations.

How to diagnose it

  • The status response contains supported indexing progress.
  • Inspect the error reference and the affected component’s current observation before selecting a recovery action.

How to fix it

  • The /health response had no usable memory-index progress, and /api/agent/version/check shows knowledge.memory_index neither running nor installed at the revision this page expects, so the Server build does not match this page. Confirm Knowledge status in System Health, then update the Server through Settings › Setup › Server updates; the missing progress field alone does not prove the indexing service is down.
  • Open System Health to check page/server compatibility. The missing progress field alone does not prove the indexing service is down.

Retry and execution caution

  • The status response contains supported indexing progress.

How to verify the fix

  • The status response contains supported indexing progress.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained task data or repeat an operation with an unknown outcome.

Technical notes

  • Status checks do not replay tasks or modify source documents.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
